summary.text: Michael Stoddard is the Libertarian Party nominee for Utah's 3rd Congressional District, chosen at the party's convention on April 18, 2026. He is making his second run for the seat, having appeared on the ballot as the Libertarian candidate in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Stoddard first ran for the 3rd District in 2022, when he was one of five candidates on the general election ballot.
He received 2.9% of the vote (8,287 votes), finishing third behind Rep. John Curtis, who won with 64.4%, and Democrat Glenn J. Wright.
